summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 2 Authentication & Identity features for The Culinary Editorial. All 19 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend auth flows tested and working: Login, Sign Up, Forgot Password, Reset Password, Guest Checkout, Logout, Navbar session state.

minor.issue: Fixed: Was returning 500 due to duplicate key error on empty email. Changed to use unique guest email format.

critical_code_review_comments: Auth implementation follows best practices: JWT httpOnly cookies, bcrypt password hashing, brute force protection
CORS properly configured with explicit frontend origin for credentials
Admin seeding is idempotent - updates password if changed
Google OAuth via Emergent Auth properly implemented with session_token cookie
Guest session now uses unique email per guest to avoid duplicate key errors
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded on startup via ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 auth fully tested. All auth endpoints working: register, login, logout, me, forgot-password, reset-password, guest-session, google/callback. Brute force protection implemented but full lockout testing limited in load-balanced environment (counters split across backend IPs). Apple and Facebook social login buttons are MOCKED (visual placeholders only). Google login is functional via Emergent Auth.
